faqs.question: Does SMU Consultants charge any agency or counselling fee for university admissions?
faqs.answer: No. Our study abroad counselling, course shortlisting, university application submission, SOP review, and visa filing support for partner institutions in the UK, Germany, Italy, and Cyprus carry zero agency service fee. Students only pay official university application fees (where applicable) and embassy charges directly.

faqs.question: Can I apply to UK universities with a study gap or without IELTS?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many UK partner universities accept up to 2–5 years of verified work experience or study gap with a strong Statement of Purpose. Depending on your intermediate or bachelor marks (typically 70%+ in English), several universities also accept MOI (Medium of Instruction), PTE Academic, Duolingo English Test (DET), or an internal English test.

faqs.question: How does zero-tuition public university admission in Germany work for Pakistani students?
faqs.answer: German public universities generally charge €0 tuition per semester (only a €150–€350 semester contribution covering transport). To qualify for the German student visa, students demonstrate financial sustenance via an official Blocked Account (Sperrkonto — approx. €11,904/year). We handle Uni-Assist, VPD evaluation, APS/embassy prep, and Blocked Account setup.

faqs.question: What is the Italy DSU regional scholarship and can it cover living costs?
faqs.answer: DSU (Diritto allo Studio Universitario) scholarships in Italy are merit- and income-based regional grants that can provide a 100% university tuition fee waiver, subsidized/free accommodation or meal vouchers, plus an annual cash stipend of €6,000–€7,500 depending on the region (such as Lombardy, Emilia-Romagna, Lazio, or Piedmont).

faqs.question: How fast can I get an offer letter and student visa for Cyprus?
faqs.answer: Cyprus admissions move very quickly—most accredited colleges and universities issue conditional or unconditional offer letters within 5 to 7 working days. With low initial tuition deposits (€3,400–€7,800/year options) and streamlined attestation, it is an ideal option for students seeking fast-track European admissions.

faqs.question: Should I take IELTS Academic, PTE Academic, or Duolingo English Test (DET)?
faqs.answer: IELTS Academic/UKVI is universally accepted across UK, Europe, Australia, and Canada. PTE Academic is 100% computer-scored with fast 48-hour results and strong UKVI/Australian/European acceptance—making our Rs. 20,000 PTE Online Mega Offer popular for quick score targets. Duolingo (DET) is ideal for rapid home testing if accepted by your shortlisted university. Join a free diagnostic demo so Sir SM Usman can recommend the fastest score path for you.

faqs.question: How do I join a free demo class at Gulshan, Shahrah-e-Faisal, Nazimabad, or Online?
faqs.answer: Simply choose your preferred Campus / Location in the Free Demo section above—the available class days and timing slots for that campus will appear automatically underneath. Submit your name and WhatsApp number or tap the WhatsApp button, and our coordinator will confirm your seat immediately.

faqs.question: What documents are required to start my 2026–2028 study abroad assessment?
faqs.answer: To begin your free eligibility check, bring or send scanned copies of your Matric/O-Level & Inter/A-Level transcripts, Bachelor degree & mark sheets (for Master applicants), valid passport, updated CV, and any existing IELTS/PTE/DET score (or MOI letter). You can upload/submit your details on the Apply page in under 2 minutes.
